jobs.title: Elite Executive Protection Specialist – Global Travel
jobs.description:
Prosegur in Irving, TX is seeking an Executive Protection Agent to provide covert and overt protection for a designated client in Dallas/Fort Worth and surrounding areas. The role requires flexibility for odd hours, frequent travel, and coordinating with a multi-department team.

Ideal candidates will have 8+ years combined experience in protective operations, strong communication skills, and a proven ability to manage high-pressure situations while maintaining confidentiality.

jobs.title: Executive Protection Specialist — Global Travel
jobs.description:
Prosegur Security USA, Inc in Dallas/Ft. Worth is seeking an experienced Executive Protection Agent to provide covert and overt protection and driving for the designated client.

You will work independently, respond to incidents, and coordinate with Executive Protection Management. This role requires up to 25% travel, nights and weekends as needed, high emotional intelligence, and the ability to brief and instruct staff on security procedures.
